Hi Julia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — EmberWave looks like a great fit for our lab equipment purchases. Before we can route POs, procurement needs the final vendor master profile filled out and any outstanding verification docs. I attached the vendor intake form with the fields we still need completed.

Could you confirm the following items this week so we can open the first PO: 
- Legal entity exact name for payments (as it appears on the W-9)
- Remit address and preferred invoice email
- Primary AP contact + phone number
- Confirmation of tax classification (W-9 provided)

Attachments: emberwave_vendor_form.pdf (PDF — vendor intake form)

Next steps
- If you can return the completed form + signed W-9, I will loop in Naomi (AP) to confirm bank/ACH fields and get the supplier record created. Grace, can you reserve a vendor code for this once we have the docs?

Appreciate it — small timeline pressure on this PO (targeting week of 12/13).

Best,

Thanks Julia — this is great and should be sufficient for initial setup. Quick checklist for AP: 
- Received signed W-9 (emberwave_w9_signed.pdf) — good
- Certificate of insurance (emberwave_certificate_insurance.pdf) — good
- We still need bank routing + account name or a voided check/ACH authorization to enable direct deposit. Julia, can you send ACH instructions or a bank letter?

Grace — once we have the ACH details, can procurement create the vendor master record and tag it with the initial PO limits? Ben mentioned a PO the week of 12/13. We should set a $25k initial single-PO limit and have standard 60-day payment terms unless legal asks otherwise.

Ben — I will not create the supplier record until I have bank details. If EmberWave prefers to be paid by check, we can skip ACH but that slows payment.

Naomi Feldman
AP Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

Julia — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the attachments. Julia replied offline with ACH details and a scanned voided check to finance@redwood.ai; Naomi, please confirm receipt and if everything passes the bank verification, can we request the vendor code and turn the PO?

Grace — if AP signs off today, please provision the vendor code in the procurement portal and set the initial PO limit as discussed. I'll mark the opportunity in the CRM as "ready to transact" and email the buyer to schedule the PO issuance.

Action items summary:
- Julia/EmberWave: confirm ACH / send voided check to AP (completed — quoted, pending Naomi confirmation)
- Naomi: verify bank docs and create supplier record once verified
- Grace: create vendor code and configure PO limit once Naomi gives the go-ahead
- Ben: update CRM + notify procurement buyer to issue PO

Thanks all — if we can close this by EOD tomorrow, procurement can issue the PO for the lab order the following week.

Cheers,
Ben
